Guidance & outlook: 14% EBITDA margin is very decent during half year FY26 and we have still annual capacity of 100 megawatt.

Sahaj Solar Limited May 18, 2026 This 4.8 megawatt project was already awarded during the last financial year, that is FY26, and it will be 100% executed during this financial year FY27 and we have already started executing it.
Going forward, we are guiding for a 30% revenue growth in FY27.
Growth & demand: Despite of all the challenges, we managed to increase our turnover to INR419 crores from INR329 crores in the previous year and we have seen 27% growth during the year.
The result is very impressive for us and as you can see, revenue has increased to INR308 crores in half year 2, which represents 33% year-on-year growth.

So this INR402 crores order book and the upcoming order book which may be confirmed during this quarter out of the total order book, this INR402 crores is very much executable during this financial year.
Margins & costs: EBITDA has rose to 25% representing INR43 crores and PAT has also increased 9% on a year- on-year basis.

And we further believe that and we are of the strong opinion that our revenue growth will b e 30% plus in the upcoming 3 years and we are very much sure of maintaining 12% plus EBITDA in the next 3 years.
Sahaj Solar Limited May 18, 2026 EBITDA margin has reduced by 31 basis points and PAT margin has remained stable, but PAT margin has impact overall due to increase in interest cost.
Capex & expansion: So we are under execution of 4.8 megawatt DREBP government plant.
So it is generally INR9 lakhs to INR35 lakhs is the average cost of the BMC, bulk milk chiller and it depends on the liter capacity, which is say 150 liter to 10,000 liters for BMC.
So current capacity is same 100 megawatt and it is currently utilized at 60% capacity, roughly near 60% capacity.
Balance sheet & cash: But from February 2026, the flows have started coming in and we are now in a very comfortable situation of the working capital and we have repaid our INR100 crores working capital loan of IREDA during the first week of April 2026, which is mentioned in the presentation.

The debtor's cycle has started improving gradually and with the new loan of INR125 crores from IREDA and the new cash flow coming in, we are very much posit ive that from this half year 2, the operating cash flow will be positive.
So, receivables have increased sharply to around INR323 crores and debt -equity has also risen to 1.27x.
Risks & challenges: These statements are not the guarantee of future performance and involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
As t he year was a challenging year considering the geopolitical situation, supply chain challenges as well as the delayed payments.

So in the supply chain disruption, we had seen very significant disruption in the last quarter, specifically the last six weeks of the year and that's where the maximum pressure of the connecting supply chain is on the companies.

So one more thing sir we have guided around 30% of the revenue CAGR over the next 3 years.
